$comment: How each agent of .agents/agents/ is graded, and what it may write. gradedBy names the skills whose procedure and report the agent's output is held to: the skill the agent runs, or, when it runs no single one, the skill that defines and judges what it returns. writes says whether the agent may write: false makes it read-only, and the write guard (scripts/agent-harness/write-guard/) refuses its writes outside the OS temp dir; true makes it a writer, which the guard asks the human about only before it edits a rule file. surface, optional beside writes: true, holds a writer to those repository-relative folders. verify:agent-context fails an agent with no entry, an entry with no gradedBy or no writes, a gradedBy naming a folder of .claude/skills/ that holds no SKILL.md, a malformed surface, and any other key.
